description: NaGe₂P₃O₁₂ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3c space group. Na is bonded in a hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.43 Å. Ge is bonded to six O atoms to form GeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.87 Å) and three longer (1.90 Å) Ge-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-35°. All P-O bond lengths are 1.54 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ge and one P atom.
